name: 10041 · New York, NY
findings: ZIP 10041 (New York) has 11 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (82%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
